name: 訪問者・注文マーカーと地域ラベルを重ねるLive View地図面
prompt:
Recreate only the supplied Shopify Live View map surface as a faithful Japanese localization. The exact crop is 952x1060 pixels (0.898:1). Preserve the tall near-square map framing and the exact visible geographic extent: North America centered, Central America and the northern half of South America below, the Pacific at left, the Atlantic at right, clipped Greenland/Europe at the far-right edge, and Hawaii near the lower-left. Do not add the left metrics card, search bar, page toolbar, or surrounding dashboard.

Use the source's minimalist map style: very pale gray land against an almost white ocean, fine white internal borders between Canadian provinces and US states, and compact dark labels. Keep the visible two-letter province/state abbreviations in their approximate source positions. Translate country labels to Japanese in place: カナダ, アメリカ合衆国, メキシコ, キューバ, プエルトリコ, グアテマラ, ニカラグア, ベネズエラ, スリナム, コロンビア, エクアドル, ブラジル, ペルー, ボリビア, パラグアイ, チリ, ウルグアイ. Retain a partially clipped 「グリーンランド」 label at the far-right edge.

Preserve the single visible purple order pin on the California coast at the same position. Do not add visitor markers where none are visible in the source. At the bottom-right, keep the small white rounded-square plus zoom control. Along the bottom edge, preserve the legend with a purple dot and 「注文」, and a cyan dot with 「現在の訪問者」; allow the legend to be slightly clipped by the lower crop edge as in the source.

Keep the map projection, land footprint, state boundaries, label density, marker placement, zoom control, legend alignment, and 952x1060 composition faithful to the supplied crop. No additional pins, roads, borders, labels, map cards, or decorative UI. Use the crop as the authority for geographic extent and visible state.
reviewNotes: v001 preserves the North/Central/South America map footprint, regional abbreviation distribution, localized country labels, single California order pin, bottom-right plus control and bottom legend. Candidate 1189x1323 (0.8987:1) matches the 952x1060 source (0.8981:1) within 0.1%; side-by-side geographic comparison is strong.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
